programme.title: The Desperate Riders
programme.desc: In this Western starring country western star Trace Adkins, Tom Berenger, and Drew Waters, a loner hero and a pretty sharpshooter help a boy rescue his mother, who’s been taken by an outlaw.

programme.title: The Jade Pendant
programme.desc: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

programme.title: Sanctified
programme.desc: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, 'Sanctified' is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance at a local church.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: The Desperate Riders
programme.desc: In this Western starring country western star Trace Adkins, Tom Berenger, and Drew Waters, a loner hero and a pretty sharpshooter help a boy rescue his mother, who’s been taken by an outlaw.

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: A Way Off Day Off
programme.desc: When Ash and friends find a wonderful island brimming with many kinds of fruit trees, they decide to take a break and enjoy the bounty! Of course, Team Rocket has other ideas…

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Wherefore Art Thou, Pokémon?
programme.desc: Our heroes meet a couple of Trainers who don't seem to get along at all, even though their Nidoran are obviously smitten with each other. Misty is determined to solve this romantic challenge!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Git Along, Little Pokémon
programme.desc: Slogging through a thunderstorm, our heroes notice a group of Magnemite soaking up electricity from the lightning bolts. When they finally get into town to rest, there's a blackout! Can the Magnemite help?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: The Mystery Menace
programme.desc: In Trovitopolis City, Ash and friends hear stories about some kind of monster that's been scaring everyone—and when the ground cracks open and dumps them in the sewer, it seems they might meet this monster face to face!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Misty Meets Her Match
programme.desc: After Misty dives into a whirlpool to rescue a girl, she learns that the girl's brother, Rudy, has a giant crush on her. Things get more complicated when it turns out he's also the Gym Leader Ash must challenge next!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Bound For Trouble
programme.desc: Ash and friends go in search of super-sized Pokémon, but when they fall for a Team Rocket trick, and then Pikachu and Meowth get snatched up by a giant Pidgeot, everyone must work together to get them back!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Charizard Chills
programme.desc: After hearing about Ash from the Trovita Island Gym Leader, another Trainer seeks him out for a battle...and after Pikachu is knocked out, Ash turns to his Charizard. But can he get the unruly Pokémon to listen to him?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: The Pokémon Water War
programme.desc: Our heroes’ plans are interrupted by a raging fire in a nearby warehouse. When they try to fight the flames, they quickly find themselves in need of the local fire department: Team Wartortle!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Pokémon Food Fight
programme.desc: When Snorlax's Poké Ball breaks, Ash has a huge problem on his hands: How can our heroes get the slumbering Snorlax over a mountain pass to the nearest Pokémon Center?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Pokémon Double Trouble
programme.desc: Ash is anxious to win the final badge of the Orange League, and soon gets a taste of this Gym Leader’s strength as she helps him fend off another Team Rocket sneak attack!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: The Wacky Watcher
programme.desc: Discovering a scientist’s submarine at sea, our heroes are soon surrounded by his life’s research: a school of splashing Magikarp! They want to help him study Magikarp Evolution, but Team Rocket has other ideas…

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: The Stun Spore Detour
programme.desc: With Ash and Tracey paralyzed by a wild Vileplume’s Stun Spore, it’s up to Misty to find a local plant and save the day!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Hello Pummelo
programme.desc: With his four Orange League badges in hand, Ash has one last challenge to face before he can be crowned Champion of the Orange League. Does he have what it takes?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Enter The Dragonite
programme.desc: Ash’s battle for the Orange League Winner’s Trophy rages on, and it soon becomes apparent that he will have to take on a powerful Dragonite to become the Orange League Champion!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: Viva Las Lapras
programme.desc: Trying to rescue a local school of Lapras from would-be poachers, our heroes must find a way to convince these distrustful Pokémon they are friends...before it’s too late!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: The Underground Round Up
programme.desc: With Pallet Town on their minds, our heroes are searching for a ferry, but soon discover the port is abandoned...except for some explosive Electrode! Can Ash stop Team Rocket before the ferry goes up in smoke?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: A Tent Situation
programme.desc: Ash has an eventful homecoming with a surprise visit from an old friend, a visit to see Professor Oak, and a Team Rocket raid. There’s no place like home!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: A Rivalry Revival
programme.desc: After Gary comes to the rescue against Team Rocket, Ash seizes an opportunity…at long last, our hero gets to challenge his rival to their very first Pokémon battle!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Ash begins his journey in Johto, a region largely unexplored and populated with Pokémon entirely new to him and his friends.

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: On the road again, Ash and his Charizard soundly defeat an ambitious rookie Trainer named Casey. Upset, she runs away before Ash can comfort her—the perfect time for Team Rocket to strike!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: In a forest that's being destroyed by rampaging Pinsir, Ash has to enlist the help of the local Heracross to protect their home! But it turns out these Pokémon look tougher than they act…

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: On their way to Violet City, our heroes arrive in a valley where Donphan are used to harvest precious stones. Needless to say, the Team Rocket villains aren't far behind them!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: The forest can be a scary place at night, especially when you’re lost! Our heroes will need some help to get out of this mess. It's Hoothoot to the rescue!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: On their first stop in a city since New Bark Town, our heroes decide to help an insecure Bellossom dance troupe regain their confidence and perform in an upcoming exhibition!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Ash and the gang arrive in a town besieged by apparent copycat crimes mimicking a legendary master thief. The town’s hopes lie with these young Trainers...how can they stop this criminal duo and their Meowth accomplice?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: When our heroes return an unhappy Snubbull to its wealthy Trainer, it sparks off a series of events that will change the Pokémon’s life forever!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: When Brock discovers a hurt and frightened Stantler in a nearby park, he decides to nurse it back to health. But with Jessie, James and Meowth on his case, can he keep Stantler safe?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Still on the road to Violet City, Ash encounters a wild Chikorita and tries to catch it. Chikorita proves to be a tougher opponent than he originally thought, and things only get worse when Team Rocket arrives…

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Professor Oak’s errand to deliver the mysterious GS Ball to a Poké Ball expert is interrupted when a Quagsire with an eye for round objects steals the GS Ball for a nocturnal ritual…

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Under yet another Team Rocket ambush, a young Trainer and her Ledyba help our heroes see them off. But, amidst the chaos, her Ledyba get separated from the group—where could they be?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Our heroes make a rest stop in a Pokémon Center, which is run by a kind-hearted but misguided Blissey. Things only get worse when an old friend of Blissey's drops in unexpectedly…

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Finally reaching Violet City, Ash’s search for the Gym is halted by a trip to the local Pokémon Academy. Ash does well playing teacher, until one pupil takes off with Pikachu!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: It’s finally time for Ash’s first Johto League Gym battle, and he’s feeling confident. But Falkner’s Flying-type Pokémon prove to be tough competition! Can Ash take the win—and his first Gym badge?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Back on the road after his first Johto Gym badge win, Ash and the gang find a cute Marill that won’t stop crying! Nothing our heroes try will stop it, and a Team Rocket raid certainly won’t help!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes pasan por una aldea de montaña a tiempo para la migración anual de Chinchou. Los aldeanos siempre envían entrenadores para proteger a los Chinchou en su viaje, pero ¿bastarán para detener al Equipo Rocket?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando el hogar de la familia de un entrenador es amenazado por los Corsola que viven cerca, Ash y sus amigos deben rescatarlos... ¡Y quizás Misty al fin pueda atrapar al Corsola que ha estado buscando!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de que nuestros héroes pierden un ferry, conocen a un buzo, quien les ofrece llevarlos a la siguiente isla... ¡Pero pronto se distraen con los cuentos del tesoro a bordo de un barco hundido!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando no están compitiendo en la Copa Remolino, Ash y Misty tratan de ayudar a un joven entrenador cuyo Octillery ha sido rechazado por sus amigos Remoraid tras su evolución.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Luego de ganar las rondas preliminares, Ash y Misty enfrentan a oponentes formidables en la Copa Remolino. ¡Mientras tanto, el trío del Equipo Rocket tiene el objetivo de robar el premio del torneo!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Es la segunda ronda de la Copa Remolino, ¡y Ash y Misty deben enfrentarse uno al otro! ¿Quién saldrá victorioso? ¿Y el plan del Equipo Rocket para distraer a la policía tendrá éxito?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes tienen el deber de proteger una aldea de los merodeadores que amenazan con huir con los Diglett que viven ahí. Y gracias a una deliciosa cena, el Equipo Rocket también se ofrece a ayudar.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes conocen a un joyero que les cuenta la leyenda de la cuarta isla Remolino… ¡Y pronto se encuentra envuelto en un plan del Equipo Rocket!
programme.sub-title: El robo de las alas plateadas

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: El pequeño Lugia llamado Silver ha caído en las manos de Butch y Cassidy del Equipo Rocket, y con la ayuda de Richie, Ash debe ganar la confianza del Lugia adulto antes de caer en la misma trampa.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Mientras Ash trata de rescatar a dos Lugia del Equipo Rocket, ¡Ash y sus amigos son hechos prisioneros! Ahora, deben hallar una forma de escapar... ¡Y de liberar también a los Pokémon capturados!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Ash y sus amigos van en un avión hacia Ciudad Olivine cuando quedan atrapados en una terrible tormenta que también atrapa al globo del Equipo Rocket. Tendrán que trabajar juntos para aterrizar a salvo... ¿Pero podrán hacerlo?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de varias interrupciones, incluyendo otro Plan del Equipo Rocket, la batalla de Ash contra Jasmine en el Gimnasio Olivine finalmente está en marcha.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando los Pokémon del laboratorio del profesor Oak en Kanto no se llevan bien, el profesor le pide a Ash que mande a su Bulbasaur al laboratorio para que lo ayude a mantener la paz.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: En Ciudad Ecruteak, nuestros héroes encuentran a su amiga Sakura y su recién evolucionado Espeon. Sakura y sus hermanas se preparan para una competencia de baile, pero el Equipo Rocket acecha, tratando de robar a sus Pokémon…

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando Ash encuentra a su viejo rival Gary preparándose para inscribir a su Arcanine en una carrera, decide competir también. Pero primero, tendrá que alejar al Equipo Rocket de la Guardería Pokémon.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando los huevos Pokémon de Ash desaparecen, nuestros héroes piden la ayuda de una desafortunada Oficial Jenny. Pronto se dan cuenta de que, si quieren recuperar el huevo, tendrán que buscarlo ellos mismos.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario pasa por un momento bastantemente embarazoso cuando francisco le lleva una serenata al salón de clase. Mientras EL Coloso celebrar que El Mexicano le hizo caso y así en vez de ganar puntos con ella haría todo lo contrario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le pide disculpas a Rosario y le dice que recuerde que un día prometieron vivir uno junto al otro, que nunca la abandonará y luchará siempre por su amor, pero ella le dice que no la siga y que no la busque.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El coloso llega a buscar a Emiliano para burlarse más de él, pero el mexicano ya no tiene más paciencia y desata una pelea de grandes proporciones. Todos están a la expectativa del final de este encuentro.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Andres le dice a Rosario y a Leticia que la bronca con Molina y Lara, fue cosa de tragos, pero que si ellos no tienen límites, lo mejor es que ellas hablen con ellos y pongan esos límites.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Don Memo indaga para saber la verdad sobre Francisco, de donde viene, quien es en realidad, buscando darle la mejor oportunidad para que su vida tome un rumbo, pero el amor de Lara por Rosario no cederá e irá hasta las últimas consecuencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario llega al Bar donde canta Lara para hablar con él. Lara y Rosario se dedican canciones que llegarán hasta lo más profundo de sus corazones.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: Kermit Apio
programme.sub-title: There's No I in Self Esteem
programme.desc: Born and raised in Honolulu, Hawaii, Kermet Apio enjoyed a childhood in paradise. He spent his time watching television, playing, and procrastinating everything else. To this day, he still does all three extensively. After graduating from high school, Kermet moved to Seattle to attend the University of Washington. Seattle became home. In early 1989, Kermet did his first open mike night at the Comedy Underground in Seattle. Comedy was a fun hobby. In May of 1990, he quit his job, said good bye to health care and benefits, and took the leap to performing full time. It is still his only job skill. He was the winner of the 2009 Great American Comedy Festival and has had numerous appearances on television and radio. He has showcased at comedy festivals in Aspen, Las Vegas, and Vancouver and has performed in 47 states and 3 Canadian provinces. He is a past winner of the Seattle Comedy Competition and was a semi-finalist in the San Francisco Comedy Competition. Also, in 1988 he was Dishwasher of the Month at the Sea-Tac Airport Dennyís. Kermet is married and the proud father of two wonderful children. He enjoys his family, baseball, and pie. He does not enjoy opera, sitting in traffic, and writing about himself in the third person.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The History and Achievements of the Islamic Golden Age

programme.sub-title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife

programme.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11
